calc_items.title: Corrected age and PMA
calc_items.question: An infant was born at 30 weeks and is now 18 weeks old (chronological). Calculate the corrected age and the current postmenstrual age.

calc_items.title: CSF/serum glucose ratio
calc_items.question: CSF glucose is 32 mg/dL and simultaneous serum glucose is 96 mg/dL. Calculate the CSF:serum glucose ratio.
calc_items.working: 32 / 96 = 0.333 ≈ 0.33; a low ratio is concerning in the right clinical context.

calc_items.title: EEG frequency
calc_items.question: A generalized spike-wave trace contains 18 complete cycles in 6 seconds. What is the frequency?

calc_items.title: GBS IVIg arithmetic
calc_items.question: IVIg is ordered at 0.4 g/kg/day for 5 days for a 12-kg child. Calculate the daily and the total mass.
calc_items.working: Daily = 0.4 × 12 = 4.8 g; total over 5 days = 24 g (arithmetic on an explicitly prescribed regimen).
